evidence_basis: Official Pepperstone EU cost documents from 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 consistently describe index-market commission as included/reflected in the spread rather than charged separately.
Current 2026 Pepperstone index/CFD pricing continues to state no commission on index CFDs.
This is treated as policy-structure coverage adequate for coarse Stage-A Discovery, not as an immutable per-day Certification ledger.
limitations: No claim is made that every individual historical day has an independently archived effective-date document.
This artifact does not establish exact Certification fill or fee truth.
A later contradictory official historical document would supersede this Discovery policy coverage for the affected interval.
